actions.title: Publish the canonical target registry
actions.verification: The merged .github governance validates the transitional target registry and prepared final architecture with fail-closed counter-proofs.
actions.counterProof: Duplicate one source repository across targets or drift the prepared final counts; validation must fail.
actions.rollback: Revert the governance commit; no source repository mutation is required.

actions.title: Activate consolidation freeze and stop-the-line limits
actions.verification: The merged freeze policy is active and the live collector returns STOPPED when PR, consolidation, or SLA thresholds are exceeded.
actions.counterProof: Disable the freeze, automatic archive protections, or threshold enforcement; governance/live tests must fail.
actions.rollback: A reviewed policy change can alter the freeze; no automatic unfreeze is permitted.

actions.title: Generate live repository and pull-request triage evidence
actions.verification: The read-only live workflow produced a 112/112 repository snapshot with bounded PR, CI, SLA and consolidation evidence.
actions.counterProof: Remove one registered repository or enable automatic mutation in a synthetic live snapshot; strict validation must fail.
actions.rollback: Disable the read-only scheduled workflow; generated reports are disposable evidence.

actions.title: Use automation-control-plane as the prepared AgentOps base
actions.verification: Review draft PR 4 and its current product-owner evidence; A01 does not convert a rehearsal into a source migration or release.
actions.counterProof: A required AgentOps invariant that cannot be implemented safely, or stale moved-head evidence, keeps this non-final.
actions.rollback: Keep existing source repositories active and change the selected base only through reviewed governance.

actions.title: Resolve the three Shipcheck identities
actions.verification: One canonical package and CLI plus tested compatibility aliases and migration documentation are required from the product owner.
actions.counterProof: Change only README branding while package or CLI identity remains split; the identity gate must fail.
actions.rollback: Keep existing repositories active and unarchived until the target release is verified.

actions.title: Enforce archive gates and human approval
actions.verification: Counter-proofs reject archive or final-topology activation when release, compatibility, consumers, redirect, rollback, or human approval is missing.
actions.counterProof: Mark archive automatic, remove rollback, or remove human approval; governance tests must fail.
actions.rollback: Return the source state to active or rolled-back; repository settings remain unchanged.

actions.title: Cap active consolidation review at two targets
actions.verification: The live snapshot observed 13 active consolidation targets for capacity 2 and correctly returned STOPPED rather than green.
actions.counterProof: Inject a third active consolidation target into the bounded test fixture; strict stop-the-line validation must trigger.
actions.rollback: Change the limit only through a reviewed governance policy update.

actions.title: Make runner and runtime support explicit
actions.verification: Reusable Python and Node workflows use ubuntu-24.04 and explicit supported runtime matrices.
actions.counterProof: Replace an explicit runner with a mutable latest alias; governance policy tests must reject it.
actions.rollback: Consumers can remain pinned to an earlier reviewed workflow SHA.

actions.title: Add installed artifact smoke and sdist/wheel parity checks
actions.verification: Reusable Python CI builds wheel and sdist, installs them independently, runs pip check and parity, and supports installed-artifact smoke; Node packs and installs in a clean project with optional smoke.
actions.counterProof: Remove an entry point or make wheel/sdist installed dependency sets diverge; the reusable evidence workflow must fail.
actions.rollback: Consumers retain the previous reusable workflow SHA until a replacement is reviewed.

actions.title: Add release SBOM, provenance, and trusted publishing policy
actions.verification: The common governance validator must accept a complete synthetic release-evidence candidate and reject missing SBOM, provenance, digests, protected environment, trusted publishing, or post-publication checks; real target releases remain separate evidence.
actions.counterProof: Delete one attestation, use a long-lived publishing token, point provenance at another commit, or fail post-publication smoke; the policy gate must return BLOCKED.
actions.rollback: Revert the common policy change; do not publish or alter any product release.

actions.title: Generate one evidence-first public dashboard from the registry
actions.verification: The merged profile dashboard is deterministically generated from a bounded source tied to the exact upstream live snapshot SHA and expires with its registry TTL.
actions.counterProof: Change displayed status without changing the bound source, tamper with the bounded source hash, or pass the TTL; profile CI must fail or the browser must mark the page stale.
actions.rollback: Revert the profile dashboard merge; the previous repository profile remains available.

actions.title: Inventory consumers before any redirect or archive
actions.verification: The read-only portfolio consumer inventory must scan registered repositories and consumer classes and produce current bounded evidence before redirect or archive.
actions.counterProof: Add a synthetic consumer after inventory or omit a consumer class; the archive gate must return BLOCKED.
actions.rollback: Restore source support and reverse redirects when a missed consumer appears.

actions.title: Separate release preparation from published release
actions.verification: Tag, release, artifacts, smoke, changelog, and post-publication checks must all point to one product commit.
actions.counterProof: Remove the tag or artifact; product status must fall back to PREPARED.
actions.rollback: Do not claim a published release; product release ownership remains separate from A01 governance policy.

actions.title: Complete professional profile metadata and topics
actions.verification: Account/profile metadata, homepage, pinned targets and repository topics must match verified target state through a supported GitHub mutation path.
actions.counterProof: Point the profile to an unreleased or transitional target; profile validation must fail or the change must not be applied.
actions.rollback: Restore previous account metadata and pins when a supported mutation path is available.
